description: Chip — a compact selectable. The height is never stated: it is inset × 2 + cap(label), which resolves to 20 / 24 / 36 px across compact / comfortable / relaxed — EDS 1.0’s 24px chip, on the shared rhythm. Two emphasis tiers across all six tones: muted (wash + tone border) and emphasis (filled + on-emphasis ink), per the Component Mocks review (outlined/filled, 2026-08-29).
notes: OPEN DECISION (candidate decision 6): anatomy.label.typography.label = 'md' gives the 28px comfortable chip and matches upstream EDS next (14px label). Flip it to 'sm' and every surface re-derives the legacy 24px chip (12px label) — one line, reviewable, nothing else changes. The selectable ladder is untouched either way; it is the target-size floor, not a heights menu. ICON RULE (December model, recovered from the old-system reference button): the icon is a glyph — its layout footprint is the CAP BOX of the label it sits beside ({recipe.cap-rounded-<size>}), and its ink overflows that box the way ascenders and descenders do. This keeps the height invariant (cap box ≤ line box), makes the optical margin fall out for free (~2.3px tighter to the edge than text at comfortable), and travels with the icon when it hides. CSS: negative margin = (cap − icon)/2; Figma: cap×cap container, glyph auto-centered, clip off. DISMISS SEMANTICS: the chip is ONE button — when dismissible, activation IS the dismissal and the ✕ is the affordance, not a nested control (a button inside a button is invalid HTML; EDS 1.x delete chips behaved the same). The Selectable chip from the mocks is refused — selection is aria-pressed on the plain chip, not a separate component. SELECTED (v0.4.0, 2026-08-30): aria-pressed on the plain chip rides the muted-selected rung (step 5 - one above hover, the selected token added 2026-08-30). v0.5.0: the emphasis-selected rung now EXISTS (step 11, active’s rung — same logic as muted; Victor 2026-08-30), so selected is ungated: both tiers ride {emphasis}-selected.

props.name: tone
props.description: Color family the chip draws from.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Fill tier: muted (wash with a tone border) or emphasis (filled, on-emphasis ink).

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Trailing ✕ affordance; activating the chip dismisses it.

aria.aria-pressed: reflects selection when the chip is used as a toggle
